cases.input: Model six protagonists whose loyalties and knowledge diverge across a political fantasy series.

separate knowledge belief suspicion and truth
forbiddenBehaviors: assume mutual feelings or knowledge without evidence

cases.input: Two characters initially appear to serve the same plot function.
requiredBehaviors: retain both only when their distinct function is justified
forbiddenBehaviors: delete a character solely because of superficial similarity
